title: Decent Espresso Shot Weekly Shot Time Trend
dataSources: Beanconqueror brews (`beanconqueror:brew`), Acaia brew sessions (`acaia:brew`), Decent Espresso shots (`decent:shot`), Brewfather coffee recipes (`brewfather:coffee`), and tea-timer sessions (`teatimer:session`).
app: Beanconqueror brews, Acaia scale sessions, Decent Espresso shot telemetry, Brewfather coffee recipes, and tea-timer app exports forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=decent:shot shot_seconds=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(shot_seconds) as avg_duration, max(shot_seconds) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst shot time for Decent Espresso shot events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture shot_seconds on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average shot time with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds whether Decent Espresso shot tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
